author: Vibration Control Specialist
purpose: Estimate controlled acceleration with added 3 percent effective damping
code_or_query:
F0=280; m=20000; zeta0=0.004; zeta_eff=0.035
a0=F0/(2*zeta0*m)
a1=F0/(2*zeta_eff*m)
print(f"a0={a0:.3f} m/s2 a1={a1:.3f} m/s2 reduction={a0/a1:.1f}x")
# stroke estimate: dynamic amplification of TMD mass ~ sqrt(1/(2*mu*zeta_tmd^2)) approx
mu=0.02; zeta_t=0.0857; import math
deck_amp=a1/(2*math.pi*1.9)**2*1000 # mm
tmd_amp_factor=1/(2*zeta_t) # approx relative
print(f"deck_amp~{deck_amp:.1f} mm TMD stroke~{deck_amp*tmd_amp_factor:.1f} mm")
